title: Which Meta models do what
source: Display names follow the shared Models used list (models.meta v1); ids follow GET https://api.meta.ai/v1/models
routing_note: Herma routes model requests to the Meta API at the standard tier only: point it at https://api.meta.ai/v1 (X-Upstream-Base-Url) and bring your own Meta API key. Any model id containing contributor is refused with HTTP 403 contributor_tier_refused. Other standard-tier ids that the Meta API lists, such as muse-spark-1.2, pass through unchanged. Operator-funded typed conversations need an explicit per-caller grant.

models.name: Muse Wonder 1.0
models.use: Meta's frontier model, for the hardest work: long multi-step reasoning, architecture and planning.

models.name: Muse Spark 1.3
models.use: Meta's fast Muse model, for everyday coding turns, tool calls and quick answers.
models.route: Yes. Meta API, standard tier. This is the default model.

models.name: Muse Glimmer 30B, fine-tuned by ta-amps
models.use: Tool calling: exact, schema-valid arguments for Task Object tools. Meta's open-weight model, fine-tuned by ta-amps.
models.evidence: 93.3% to 99.3% exact match on a fixed 150-task evaluation, measured once.
models.route: No. Not served by Herma: run it on your own endpoint and add that host to the upstream allowlist.

models.name: SAM 3.1
models.use: Segmentation: finds and outlines objects in images and video.
models.route: No. Herma shims text requests only; call the Meta API directly.

models.route: No. Herma shims text requests only; call the Meta API directly.
